title: Morning Prayer | When You Wake Up Tired, God Renews Your Strength
description:
Woke up tired? God gives power to the faint. Pray this morning prayer with us and receive renewed strength for today.

Chapters
0:00 Good morning
0:47 Renewed strength (Isaiah 40:31)
1:57 Isaiah 40:29
2:30 In the morning (Psalm 5:3)
3:04 Psalm 118:24
3:53 Let us pray
4:25 Isaiah 26:3
5:00 Come unto me (Matthew 11:28)
5:59 Colossians 3:23
6:27 Strength in weakness (2 Corinthians 12:9)
7:52 Psalm 73:26
9:14 Psalm 28:7
10:24 Declaration for today
10:48 Philippians 4:13
11:12 Nehemiah 8:10
11:41 Psalm 90:17
13:24 One thing to do today
13:45 Blessing

Scripture in this prayer: Isaiah 40:31; Isaiah 40:29; Psalm 5:3; Psalm 118:24; Isaiah 26:3; Matthew 11:28; Colossians 3:23; 2 Corinthians 12:9; Psalm 73:26; Psalm 28:7; Philippians 4:13; Nehemiah 8:10; Psalm 90:17; Numbers 6:24-26
